blocks.text: Photography Celebrates Its 200th Anniversary in the Heart of Le Marais

In 2026, photography turns 200. Two centuries of turning light and life into images. Join us in Paris , the city where it all began, to celebrate an art form that has never stopped reinventing the way we see the world.

To mark this anniversary, ImageNation 2026 takes over two brand-new exhibition spaces in the heart of Le Marais , during the weekend of Paris Photo , one of the major events in contemporary photography. For those few days, Paris becomes an international crossroads where gazes, languages and visions intersect.

As the city pulses with creativity, curators , artists and photography lovers from around the world gather to celebrate the power of the image . Expect striking visuals, bold perspectives and a vibrant dialogue between art, society and identity.

In the unique setting of Le Marais, the exhibition becomes a living space where artists, collectors and audiences do more than simply observe: they share a way of seeing. ImageNation Paris 2026 is an invitation to pause, to look closely, and to stay open to surprise.
On the program: 6 exhibitions , 2 galleries , 300+ international photographers , curated by Martin Vegas — and one great celebration of photography.
